title: Vertex AI Vector Search (Public Endpoint)
description: Template schema for deploying Google Cloud Vertex AI Vector Search with a public HTTPS endpoint authenticated via IAM for RAG applications.

display_name.description: Display name for the Vertex AI Vector Search Index.

description.default: Vertex AI Vector Search — Public Endpoint Deployment
description.description: Description for the Vector Search resources.

dimensions.description: Dimensionality of vector embeddings (e.g. 768 for text-embedding-004).

distance_measure_type.description: Distance metric for nearest neighbor calculations.

algorithm.description: Indexing algorithm (tree_ah uses ScaNN; brute_force performs exact search).

index_update_method.description: STREAM_UPDATE enables real-time insertion/deletion; BATCH_UPDATE uses GCS batch files.

create_staging_bucket.description: Create a GCS bucket for staging document embeddings and data.

machine_type.description: Compute machine type for serving node replicas.
